REJECT

The original passed the untrimmed `value` to `IsSigningKeyValue` (and trimmed only for the later checks), but `IsRejectedKeyValue` now passes `value.Trim()` to it, so a literal with leading or trailing whitespace can be judged differently. That is a behaviour change. (I couldn't find the source locally, so I also couldn't confirm that `lines` is really a `string[]`, as the new helper's signature assumes.)
